lead_raw_text:
The structure of MgSi2 (Mg4Si8 per cell) crystallizes in monoclinic symmetry with space group C2/c (No. 15) and 12 atoms in the unit cell across three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Mg centers with 13 neighbors (3 Mg, 10 Si) and Si centers with 9 neighbors (5 Mg, 4 Si), with the neighbor graph forming a single 3-periodic component. Validated polyhedron-sharing contacts include corner- and edge-sharing between Mg and Si polyhedra, and corner- and face-sharing among Si polyhedra.
